<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Recommend CLT 16.4 on Sequoia by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24686
* dependencies_helpers: key test cache by root by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24670
* Skip runner Docker image jobs on release by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24684
* Add `Homebrew/NoUntypedKeywordRest` cop by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24678
* info: list installed build dependents by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24681
* Add shared formula DSL helpers by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24672
* Resolve installed formula prefixes offline by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24692
* Keep prefix libexec optional during post-install by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24691
* Preserve name-only and run-only API services by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24690
* brew.sh: don't source an inherited HOMEBREW_BASH_COMMAND by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24693
* Simplify command and tooling type assertions by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24687
* Simplify runtime type assertions by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24688
* Simplify type assertions in formulae and taps by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24673
* Simplify cask assertions and enable the cop by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24674
* brew.sh, os.sh: harden against inherited environment values by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24694
* rubocops/deprecate_disable: don't guess dates by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24696
* Type positional RuboCop node matcher patterns by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24700
* Route issue reports by Homebrew support tier by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24698
* Improve root API cache guidance by @zeldrisho in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24702
* rubocops/components_redundancy: extend sha256 & git revision audit by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24520
* info: show "auto updates" not "auto_updates" by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24708
* Unify formula and cask lifecycle handling by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24703
* Share DSL modules between formulae and casks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24704
* Order pre-releases before lettered patches by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24714
* Flag unchanged CSV auto_updates apps as outdated by @kris-anderson in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24709
* rubocops/text: remove `env :userpaths` check by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24545
* Add a cop for partially split method chains by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24716
* Protect Homebrew repositories on package upgrades by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24711
* superenv: target the major macOS version by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24722
* Audit both deprecate! and disable! reasons by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24719
* Prefer disabled in remaining lifecycle checks by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24720
* info, search: label incompatible formulae and casks by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24669
* Type check more splatted calls by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24721
* Enforce one dotted call per line in wrapped chains by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24717
* Enforce the attestation trust policy by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24715
* Redraw download progress from the first column by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24728
* dependencies_helpers: share descendant expansions by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24726
* Finish interpolation fixes and enable the cop by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24731
* Fix flaky PyPI tests and reject CI skips by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24730
* Make shared DSL errors ignorable again by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24736
* uninstall: refuse to remove build dependencies by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24713
* info: load fewer formulae and less code by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24737
* Simplify expressions in package handling by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24732
* Add `args:` to the command and popen helpers by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24724
* Finish ternary fixes and enable the cop by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24734
* Finish interpolation fixes and enable the cop by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24735
* Load `timeout` for curl downloads by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24749
* rubocops/on_system: fix `unless` OS and CPU advice by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24745
* Name `HOMEBREW_CASK_OPTS` on a shell syntax error by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24743
* Skip sudo for cask delete paths that don't exist by @blineadam in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24746
* Load `timeout` for curl downloads by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24750

## New Contributors
* @zeldrisho made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24702
* @kris-anderson made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24709
* @blineadam made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24746

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.15...7.0.16
